Description: With this app, you can manage purchase orders, create new purchase orders, and monitor existing purchase orders.
Process and post outgoing payments to suppliers, clear open items, and handle differences.
Process outgoing payments, verify payment terms, and execute payment execution runs.
Create, search, change, and monitor sales orders throughout the order fulfillment lifecycle.
Verify and post supplier invoices with reference to purchase orders or without reference.
Receive and process incoming payments from customers and clear associated open customer invoices.
Display and maintain exchange rates between international currencies.
Display and reverse journal entries, navigate to line items, and inspect ledger postings.
Create and post general ledger journal entries across multiple ledger groups.
Process goods receipt, goods issue, and stock transfer orders for inventory management.
Create, display, and maintain business partner master data for customers and suppliers.
Open and close posting periods by company code, account type, and fiscal year variant.
Maintain chart of accounts, company code assignments, and G/L account attributes.
Define and maintain number range intervals for financial and procurement documents.
